content.title: CORT Q3 Deep Dive: Pharmacy Transition and Pipeline Expansion Drive Mixed Outlook
content.summary: Biopharma company Corcept Therapeutics (NASDAQ:CORT) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales rose 13.7% year on year to $207.6 million.
